facets.description: database.go updateDevice: on MySQL, RowsAffected counts changed rows rather than matched rows, so an identical UPDATE on an existing device returns 0 and is wrongly rejected with ErrDeviceLimitReached

database.go updateDevice: clock skew pushes the stored updated_at outside the [UpdatedAt-30d, UpdatedAt+1min] window, so an existing device matches 0 rows and is wrongly rejected with ErrDeviceLimitReached
